title: Erdős-Kac theorems for discriminants of number fields
summary: The classical Erdős-Kac theorem gives a central limit theorem for the number of prime divisors of a random integer. We prove an analog for the number of ramified primes in a random $G$-extension of a number field when $G$ is abelian. This builds on previous work of Lemke Oliver and Thorne in the cases $G = S_d$ ($2 \le d \le 5$), and provides the first examples where local ramification events at distinct primes are not independent.
